impact_assessment.why: Repair refused whenever any unrelated file was dirty, so a concurrent session blocked a reviewed safety fix; the user needs Reforge to fix its findings without taking over or committing another agent's work.
impact_assessment.benefits: Findings can be applied and verified while other work is in progress; only a commit whose target file was already dirty is refused, and unrelated paths are never staged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: fix/run no longer require a clean tree; dependency: none; concurrency: a fingerprint detects unrelated dirty paths changing during repair; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Snapshot and restore targets, fingerprint pre-existing unrelated paths, allow them only in the diff review, exclude them from commit_paths, and pin every case with integration tests plus an ADR.

checkpoints.description: [1/5] Finish the host-review pivot and remove the AI orchestration

impact_assessment.why: Reforge accumulated an AI review subsystem (model budgets, argv attachment, request caps, redaction and evidence rules) that duplicated what the driving agent already does; the operator wants the host agent to analyze the packet directly, with no subagents.
impact_assessment.benefits: One explicit packet/findings contract; no model calls or credentials; less code and fewer failure modes; the widening-window engine, safe repairs and delivery stay.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CLI AI options disappear and state key ai becomes review; dependency: no new deps; concurrency: unchanged per-project lock; state: schema 2 stays readable, new entries use review and old ai entries are read as fallback.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep run/audit/fix semantics, add findings-file validation tests, update README/architecture/services/SKILL, append one superseding ADR, and run the full gate triad.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Re-scoped: the packet pivot, docs, tests and gates land as one atomic commit

impact_assessment.why: The five planned milestones cannot pass Phase 4 separately because the code, README, knowledge and map must change together for the freshness, command and claim gates.
impact_assessment.benefits: One atomic, gate-passing commit instead of intermediate states whose docs still describe the deleted AI review.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the CLI drops AI options and state key ai becomes review; dependency: none; concurrency: unchanged; state: schema 2 remains readable with legacy ai fallback.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Full Phase 4 triad passed; explicit staging; ADR-263 records the removed path and the new packet contract.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Hide rejected and duplicate ideas from default listings

impact_assessment.why: The operator wants a target listing that excludes harmful rejections and already-covered duplicates while keeping both in the audit register.
impact_assessment.benefits: Future reviews see only actionable ideas; rejected and duplicate rows remain queryable and stay in MATRIX.md.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ideas hides Rejected status and duplicate tag unless the matching include flag or explicit filter is used; dependency: none; concurrency: the filter is read-only and writes keep the register lock; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add failing-first unit and CLI tests, document both flags, append ADR-264, then run the full gate shield.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Hide rejected and duplicate rows and add both opt-in flags
[3/3] Gate shield passed: tests, budgets, principles, knowledge, licenses, secrets, reachability, hygiene and dogfood; checklists: passed

impact_assessment.why: The operator authorized publishing the merged main commit, but the project permission rule denies every git push and forces a manual workaround.
impact_assessment.benefits: A tested commit can be published after an explicit human confirmation; force, mirror and delete pushes remain blocked.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: git push* becomes ask, force/mirror/delete patterns stay deny; dependency: none; concurrency: unchanged; state: no state change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Update opencode.jsonc and the permission-boundary test together, append ADR-265, run the unit and read-only gate shield, then push only after confirmation.
